name: RecurringGivingManager
tagline: Grow and protect monthly giving – retries, cards, pauses, recovery and upgrades in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete sustainer-management app for charities: MRR, ARR, churn and recovery KPIs; a failed-payment retry ladder with hard declines; card expiry alerts; pause, resume and cancel with reasons; a drag-and-drop recovery board for lapsed donors; a charge calendar with charge-run reconciliation; and an upgrade-ask pipeline with ready-made letters. Works in canvas and model-driven apps and on Power Pages.
features: MRR / ARR, at-risk MRR, churn and recovery rate
Retry ladder with configurable days and hard declines
Pause with maximum length, resume, cancel with reasons
Upgrade asks with suggested amount and letter
Bulk payment, contact, ask, export and cancel
